## Theme

Which `.user.css` file (Ellen, Jane, Madoka Light, Madoka Dark, Homura)?

## Console

- Model: UDM Pro / UDM Pro SE / other
- UniFi OS version:
- UniFi Network version (if the broken page is inside Network):
- How you opened it: `unifi.ui.com` or a local host/IP
- Browser and Stylus version:
- Built-in UniFi appearance: Light or Dark

## What broke

What still looks like stock UniFi, and which page (dashboard, settings, login, Protect, and so on)?

## Extra detail that helps

A screenshot of the page is enough. Do not include account emails, passwords, or WAN IP addresses.

If you are comfortable with browser devtools, the class attribute and element name of one unstyled box (for example `div` / `section`, and whether the class looks hashed like `css-network-ab12`) tells us whether the console changed selectors.
